title: MCP through the installed proxy: setup view, default view, full-catalog override, read, render and a geometry.buffer job
promise: An agent configured with the installed honua-mcp-proxy discovers the bounded setup view, sees the default view without a selector, gets the full catalog only when authenticated, and reads, renders and runs a buffer job, all through the proxy's stdio.

steps.description: initialize with _meta["honua.io/workflow-view"] = "setup"; the server answers the supported protocol and its identity.
A selector-free tools/list in that session returns the complete setup view with the fixture's tool count.
A new session initialized without a selector lists the complete default view with the fixture's tool count.
An anonymous tools/list that asks for the full view is refused with permission_denied.

An authenticated tools/list for the full view, drained page by page, returns exactly the pinned tool roster (e2e/drivers/mcp/expected-tools.json, names, no duplicates) including the default view; a later selector-free tools/list returns the initialized view again.
tools/call honua_query_features with the fixture filter; the features equal the filtered fixture rows with exact ordinates.
tools/call honua_render_map over the area layer; every sampled pixel inside the fixture polygon is painted and every sampled pixel outside it is transparent.
tools/call honua_execute_plan with a geometry.buffer step for the fixture point; a job id is returned.
resources/read the job until it is terminal; it succeeded.
resources/read the job results; every ring vertex lies at the fixture distance from the fixture point and the centroid is the point.
